name: EPIC 201713289
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.3 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201713289 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.349831 (16th-84th percentiles 7.085666-7.628068), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201713289 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.026107 (16th-84th percentiles 0.932522-1.129868), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201713289: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4671.035 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201713289 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1700.449219 (16th-84th percentiles 1649.648438-1752.96875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,700 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.03 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,671 K at its surface.
